library_preparation_preflight.summary: langchain4j-ollama talks to the Ollama REST API through langchain4j-http-client (the JDK client implementation) and Jackson. Tests can call it against an in-process fake HTTP endpoint, as the issue's Micronaut suite does, so no extra dependency, Docker image or system property is needed. Sibling langchain4j modules (cohere, voyage-ai, google-ai-gemini, http-client-jdk) already have tests in this repo, and no Ollama image is pinned in allowed-docker-images.
risks: I did not resolve the 1.21.0 POM or run the library. The decision rests on the issue text and the sibling modules in the repo.
Tests must not require a real Ollama server. If the library does not pull in langchain4j-http-client-jdk transitively, the Gradle run would show it, and the driver could add that dependency then.
Coverage needs chat, streaming and embeddings calls against a fake endpoint, so the Jackson request and response types (about 56, per the Micronaut metadata) get registered.
